title: El viaje de Colón
goal: Read the real story of Columbus's 1492 voyage, from the Reconquista's end to why the continent was named after someone else entirely.

items: Explain what had just happened in Spain right before Isabel funded the voyage.
Describe the crew's mood by early October 1492 and who actually sighted land.
Explain why Columbus called the people he met 'indios'.
Explain why the continent is called 'América' and not 'Colombia'.
Use the preterite to narrate a sequence of historical events.
